verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a natural-language command interface for Stripe Radar. Rules are written in a structured attribute syntax and created in the Dashboard, and reviews are handled through REST endpoints such as POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve. The official Stripe MCP server and CLI are developer building blocks and belong to separate stories, so they earn no credit toward first-party natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
